Episode 251: The Great Adversaries (9)
While Syris was leaving the glass with the manager, Jin felt a vibration from the device in his pocket. It was a communication from Talaris.
{Son-in-law, are you with my daughter right now?}
"Yes, Lady Talaris."
{Then, instead of going straight to Tikan, come to the Ice Castle. I have something to discuss, and someone to show you.}
"Someone to show me?"
{Hehe, yes, a quite mysterious person. Come and see for yourself. See you later.}
Soon after, Syris joined him outside.
"It was my mother, right?"
"Yes, Syris. She asked us to stop by the Ice Castle."
"Hmm, just now, of all times. Remember our promise to not be awkward."
"Of course, Syris."
Jin and Syris exchanged a smile. Even before their romantic feelings, they had been the closest of comrades for a long time.
"Let's go, Mort."
[Whooom!]
The white portal of the Otherworldly Snowfield opened. As Mort began to race through the snowfield, Syris, as if suddenly reminded of something, spoke up.

"Jin. Could it be that this Otherworldly Snowfield, like Silkiya's power, is somehow connected to other dimensions? The same goes for the Flame World of Tess. Both are unanalyzed territories, after all."
[Whooom.]
Mort nodded first. It wasn't a confirmation of the connection, but rather an acknowledgment of the possibility.
"Now that you mention it, it's not impossible. We should relay this to Silkiya for further research."
Mort swiftly reached the Ice Castle.
Upon arrival, Jin sensed an unfamiliar aura permeating the Palace.
'...Dragons? Were there dragons residing in the Ice Castle?'
Jin suddenly remembered a conversation he had with Syris.
-I heard from Lady Talaris during a communication last time. She said she's been making some interesting new friends these days.
-Those interesting friends are dragons. Young ones, about a thousand years old.
-Young dragons...?
-It's unusual. Dragons without affiliations are rare.
Syris seemed to recall the same conversation.
"It's common for mother's lovers to reside in the Ice Castle, but there are quite a few dragons today. They must be related to the person she wants to show you."
"It seems so."
Jin and Syris encountered many dragons on their way to the inner chambers of the Castle. Most were in human form, but their transformations were somewhat clumsy.
Their transformations were incomplete, with tails or wings sticking out, and most seemed unable to properly conceal their energy.
This was not the appearance one would expect from dragons of a thousand years. Moreover, more than half of them seemed unaware of who Jin was, tilting their heads in confusion.
"They look like dragons from another world."
"Indeed."
Upon reaching the inner chambers, they were first greeted by the members of the Golden Coil Clan.
"Oh, partner! Long time no see, you've become too famous to catch a glimpse of!"
The members of the Water Tail Clan, Darkflame, and the leaders, King Nose and King Eye, also greeted them with bright smiles.
"Jin, it's been a while. Syris, your hair, changed. It's pretty."
"Thanks, Darkflame. Where's my mother?"
"In that room. Getting a massage from the Golden Snow Clan."
In the room, along with Talaris, was someone Jin and Syris had never seen before, also receiving a massage.
"Ah, daughter, son-in-law. You're here?"
"Mother, who is the person with you...?"
"Ahaha, right, right, I need to introduce. Say hello, this is Lucy Runcandel... Your ancestor, son-in-law."
Jin and Syris's eyes widened.
Lucy Runcandel.
The last of the Ten Knights Jin had not met, presumed to be Temar's lover. This remarkable figure was unexpectedly receiving a massage in the Ice Castle with Talaris.
Talaris, noticing Jin's shocked expression, shrugged her shoulders playfully.

"Surprised? Let me explain briefly. Lucy was being chased by Ganesto in a secluded space, a kind of sub-space, and worked hard to safely exit into this world. As a result, a small dimensional rift opened near the Ice Castle, and through it, Lucy's dragons started to appear. Some even had affairs with me... and today, Lucy finally came out too."
Though Talaris's summary was brief, it covered the complex events well, and Lucy nodded in agreement, considering it fit.
"Please leave us now."
"Certainly!"
As the Golden Snow Clan members left, Talaris and Lucy stood up. Jin bowed respectfully to Lucy.
"I am Jin Runcandel, the 59th head of the Runcandel family. It's an honor to meet an ancestor like you."
"There's no need for such formalities, Lord Jin. The real Lucy Runcandel is as good as dead a thousand years ago... I am merely a phantom, or what remains of her."
Lucy extended her hand for a handshake.
Her hand, partially translucent like the past Orgal, seemed as if it would vanish soon. She then began her story.
"Lucy Runcandel, the Dragon Sword. That's what people called me a thousand years ago. Until then, I thought I was fully human, fighting alongside Temar and my comrades to protect our family."
Jin focused on her words, observing Lucy.
She appeared more demonic or dragon-like than human. Antlers like a deer adorned her head, and her eyes shone a golden hue.
That golden light symbolized the Sun Energy. She too was connected to the Sun God.
"However, after our defeat in the war, I realized... I was not a mere human. To discover what I truly was and to avoid burdening the Runcandel family, I left."
Lucy didn't take long to uncover her true nature.
Amidst numerous historical manipulations by Zipple, her unique power naturally awoke and rebelled, revealing her truth.
"I was one of the nine heads of the ancient serpent, Ameris. That's why, even during my active years, I received unusual love from dragons. That was the first aspect of my true identity."
"Hmm, the first identity... What an odd phrase. That means there's a second one, right?"

"Yes, Lady Talaris. Even as one of Ameris's heads, I couldn't have resisted the power of the origin stone with that power alone. The continuous manipulations by them revealed my second identity: I was one of the selves of the Sun God, Kinzelo."
Jin gazed into her eyes, glowing with Sun Energy, filled with an unfathomable void of sorrow.

"When I realized everything, I felt betrayed by myself. The human Lucy Runcandel was merely an illusion, and my true nature was nothing but an aberration. A head of the great serpent and a self of the Sun God... and that too, a self that blindly desired world destruction."
The will of Lucy, as the Sun God, was not a benevolent existence.
Like Elona, or 'Malugia,' Lucy was an aspect solely for the world's destruction.
"Despite fighting so fiercely to protect my family and the world, my true nature was a monster opposing the will of Temar and my comrades."
As Jin was about to carefully choose his response, Talaris spoke up again.

"It’s hard to offer comfort when we were just having a massage together with such a story. Hmm, but you know, for someone who was a self of destruction, you haven't done anything destructive, right? Instead, you appeared before us wanting to help the Vamel Alliance."
Lucy closed her eyes tightly at that. She was recalling the most painful memory of her life.
"...That's the problem. Ideally, I should have remained a monster... The power and will of destruction I possessed have been transferred to my daughter."
Jin's eyes widened again.
"Your daughter?"
"Yes, my daughter with Temar. Heilyn, Makos. Twins. My Sun God's power and will passed on to the eldest."
Lucy's departure from the Runcandel family after the war wasn't just to find herself.
It was also necessary to protect her daughters, Heilyn and Makos. Makos would later return to the Runcandels, continuing Temar's bloodline.
And it was Heilyn who inherited the Sun God's power from Lucy.
Jin immediately thought of Lokia. During the Lafrarosa Liberation War, Lokia bore an entirely different face from a thousand years ago.
The face of a woman resembling Temar.
It was Heilyn Runcandel.
"I don't know exactly how my power transferred to Heilyn. When I gave birth... I didn't know what I was, but by then, my power had already transferred to her."
Unlike the lively Makos, Heilyn never showed any normalcy from birth.

She didn't cry when born and barely spoke as she grew. Heilyn seemed more like an inanimate rock than a person. With Makos being similar to Murakan, her strangeness was inevitable without knowing the truth.
"During my escape, Zipple kept trying to manipulate my history using the broken origin stone. Each time, Heilyn remained unaffected. My power had already moved to her."
Lucy then formed a lump of Sun Energy on her palm.
Jin, Syris, and Talaris flinched, looking at the mass. It held enough power to obliterate the Ice Castle in an explosion, had the three of them not been there.
"Over 90% of my power was transferred to my daughter. Even this tiny fraction remaining with me can form such power."
Lucy clenched her fist, dispersing the energy.
"Lord Jin, I want to free my daughter from this darkness. It's shameless to ask, but please help me... I'll do everything I can."
